101:         immediately without recording, so a retry loop can never grow
102:         ``records`` (or the trace file) past the configured budget.
103:         """
104:         # Budget first: once exhausted, fail fast WITHOUT recording.
105:         max_calls = self._gateway.settings.agent_max_tool_calls
106:         if len(self.records) >= max_calls:
107:             raise ToolPolicyError(
108:                 f"tool call budget exhausted ({max_calls} per execution)",
109:                 details={
110:                     "tool": name,
111:                     "reason": "budget_exhausted",
112:                     "max_tool_calls": max_calls,
113:                 },
114:             )
115: 
116:         args = dict(arguments or {})
117:         record = ToolCallRecord(
118:             name=name, arguments=redact(args, self._secrets)
119:         )
120:         started = time.perf_counter()
121:         try:
122:             payload = await self._dispatch(name, args)
123:         except ToolPolicyError as exc:
124:             self._finish(record, started, error=f"{exc.code}: {exc.message}")
125:             raise
126:         except MCPError as exc:
127:             self._finish(record, started, error=f"{exc.code}: {exc.message}")
128:             raise
129:         except Exception as exc:
130:             self._finish(record, started, error=f"unexpected_error: {exc}")
131:             raise
132:         self._finish(record, started, summary=_summarize(payload))
133:         return payload
134: 
135:     # -- internals --------------------------------------------------------
136: 
137:     async def _dispatch(self, name: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
138:         spec = self._skill
139:         if spec.tool_policy is ToolPolicy.NO_TOOLS:
140:             raise ToolPolicyError(
141:                 f"skill '{spec.name}' is not allowed to call tools",
142:                 details={
143:                     "skill": spec.name,
144:                     "tool": name,
145:                     "reason": "no_tools",
146:                     "tool_policy": spec.tool_policy.value,
147:                 },
148:             )
149:         if name not in spec.permitted_tools:
150:             raise ToolPolicyError(
151:                 f"tool '{name}' is not permitted for skill '{spec.name}'",
152:                 details={
153:                     "skill": spec.name,
154:                     "tool": name,
155:                     "reason": "not_permitted",
156:                     "permitted_tools": list(spec.permitted_tools),
157:                 },
158:             )
159: 
160:         info = (await self._gateway.catalog()).get(name)
161:         if info is None:
162:             raise MCPError(
163:                 f"MCP server does not expose tool '{name}'",
164:                 details={
165:                     "tool": name,
166:                     "reason": "unknown_tool",
167:                     "available": sorted(await self._gateway.catalog()),
168:                 },
169:             )
170: 
171:         needs_read_only = (
172:             spec.tool_policy is ToolPolicy.READ_ONLY
173:             or self._mode is AgentMode.COPILOT
174:         )
175:         if needs_read_only and not info.read_only_hint:
176:             raise ToolPolicyError(
177:                 f"tool '{name}' is not read-only and cannot be used in "
178:                 f"mode '{self._mode.value}'",
179:                 details={
180:                     "skill": spec.name,
181:                     "tool": name,
182:                     "reason": "not_read_only",
183:                     "mode": self._mode.value,
184:                     "tool_policy": spec.tool_policy.value,
185:                 },
186:             )
187: 
188:         return await self._gateway.client.call_tool(name, args)
189: 
190:     def _finish(
191:         self,
192:         record: ToolCallRecord,
193:         started: float,
194:         *,
195:         summary: str | None = None,
196:         error: str | None = None,
197:     ) -> None:
198:         record.duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 3)
199:         record.ok = error is None
200:         record.result_summary = summary
201:         record.error = error
202:         self.records.append(record)
203:         if self._trace is not None:
204:             self._trace.event(
205:                 "tool_call",
206:                 {
207:                     "tool": record.name,
208:                     "skill": self._skill.name,
209:                     "mode": self._mode.value,
210:                     "arguments": record.arguments,
211:                     "ok": record.ok,
212:                     "duration_ms": record.duration_ms,
213:                     "result_summary": record.result_summary,
214:                     "error": record.error,
215:                 },
216:                 secrets=list(self._secrets),
217:             )
218: 
219: 
220: def _summarize(payload: Any) -> str:
221:     """A short, redaction-safe description of a tool result for records."""
222:     if isinstance(payload, list):
223:         return f"list[{len(payload)}]"
224:     if isinstance(payload, dict):
225:         return f"dict[{len(payload)}]"
226:     if isinstance(payload, str):
227:         return payload[:160]
228:     return type(payload).__name__

73:         """Load one entity's mapping records plus their source file name.

75:         For US (no mapping file) this returns ``([], None)`` — the caller uses
76:         the identity mapping instead. Records are returned verbatim (including
77:         incomplete ones) so the validator can report them; this method does
78:         not silently drop or repair anything.
79:         """
80:         entity_id = (entity or "").strip().upper()
81:         source = self.service.get_account_mapping(entity_id)
82:         source_file = source.get("source_file")
83:         entries: list[MappingEntry] = []
84:         for offset, row in enumerate(source.get("rows") or []):
85:             entries.append(
86:                 MappingEntry(
87:                     entity=entity_id,
88:                     source_file=source_file,
89:                     source_row=offset + 1,
90:                     local_code=(row.get("local_code") or "").strip(),
91:                     local_name=(row.get("local_name") or "").strip() or None,
92:                     group_code=(row.get("group_code") or "").strip(),
93:                     raw={k: (v or "") for k, v in row.items()},
94:                 )
95:             )
96:         return entries, source_file
97: 
98:     # -- validation --------------------------------------------------------
99: 
100:     def validate_mapping(
101:         self, entity: str, entries: list[MappingEntry]
102:     ) -> list[ValidationIssue]:
103:         """Validate mapping records; return structured issues (no repair).
104: 
105:         Detects:
106:         * invalid/incomplete records (missing local or group code),
107:         * duplicate mapping records (same local code recorded twice),
108:         * conflicting mappings (same local code → more than one group code),
109:         * group codes that do not exist in the group chart of accounts,
110:         * a group account whose name matches the local name but whose mapped
111:           group account differs (a probable mis-mapping, e.g. UK 2310).
112:         """
113:         issues: list[ValidationIssue] = []
114:         by_local: dict[str, list[MappingEntry]] = defaultdict(list)
115: 
116:         for entry in entries:
117:             if not entry.local_code or not entry.group_code:
118:                 issues.append(
119:                     ValidationIssue(
120:                         code="invalid_mapping_record",
121:                         severity=Severity.ERROR,
122:                         message=(
123:                             f"{entity} mapping row {entry.source_row}: missing "
124:                             f"local_code or group_code"
125:                         ),
126:                         entity=entity,
127:                         source_file=entry.source_file,
128:                         source_row=entry.source_row,
129:                         account_code=entry.local_code or None,
130:                         details={"raw": entry.raw},
131:                     )
132:                 )
133:                 continue
134:             by_local[entry.local_code].append(entry)
135: 
136:         for local_code, records in sorted(by_local.items()):
137:             group_codes = {r.group_code for r in records}
138: 
139:             # Duplicate mapping records: the same local code recorded more than
140:             # once at all.
141:             if len(records) > 1:
142:                 issues.append(
143:                     ValidationIssue(
144:                         code="duplicate_mapping_record",
145:                         severity=Severity.WARNING,
146:                         message=(
147:                             f"{entity} mapping records {local_code} appear "
148:                             f"{len(records)} times (source rows "
149:                             f"{[r.source_row for r in records]})"
150:                         ),
151:                         entity=entity,
152:                         source_file=records[0].source_file,
153:                         source_row=records[0].source_row,
154:                         account_code=local_code,
155:                         details={"source_rows": [r.source_row for r in records]},
156:                     )
157:                 )
158: 
159:             # Conflicting mappings: the same local code resolves to more than
160:             # one distinct group code. Never auto-resolved.
161:             if len(group_codes) > 1:
162:                 issues.append(
163:                     ValidationIssue(
164:                         code="conflicting_mapping",
165:                         severity=Severity.ERROR,
166:                         message=(
167:                             f"{entity} local account {local_code} maps to "
168:                             f"multiple group accounts {sorted(group_codes)}"
169:                         ),
170:                         entity=entity,
171:                         source_file=records[0].source_file,
172:                         source_row=records[0].source_row,
173:                         account_code=local_code,
174:                         details={"group_codes": sorted(group_codes)},
175:                     )
176:                 )
177: 
178:             for record in records:
179:                 if record.group_code not in self.group_coa:
180:                     issues.append(
181:                         ValidationIssue(
182:                             code="missing_group_account",
183:                             severity=Severity.ERROR,
184:                             message=(
185:                                 f"{entity} local account {local_code} maps to "
186:                                 f"group account {record.group_code!r}, which "
187:                                 f"is not in the group chart of accounts"
188:                             ),
189:                             entity=entity,
190:                             source_file=record.source_file,
191:                             source_row=record.source_row,
192:                             account_code=local_code,
193:                             details={"group_code": record.group_code},
194:                         )
195:                     )
196:                 self._check_name_mismatch(entity, record, issues)
197: 
198:         return issues
199: 
200:     def _check_name_mismatch(
201:         self, entity: str, record: MappingEntry, issues: list[ValidationIssue]
202:     ) -> None:
203:         """Flag a mapping whose group account contradicts an exact COA name.
204: 
205:         If a group account shares the mapping's ``local_name`` exactly, but the
206:         mapping points at a *different* group account, that is a probable
207:         mis-mapping worth a human review. Purely a name check against the COA —
208:         no account is hardcoded — so it fires only when the source data really
209:         contradicts itself (e.g. UK ``2310 Deferred income`` → 4100 while the
210:         COA keeps 'Deferred income' at 2300).
211:         """
212:         if not record.local_name:
213:             return
214:         wanted = record.local_name.strip().casefold()
215:         same_name = sorted(
216:             code
217:             for code, account in self.group_coa.items()
218:             if account.account_name.strip().casefold() == wanted
219:         )
220:         if same_name and record.group_code not in same_name:
221:             mapped = self.group_coa.get(record.group_code)
222:             issues.append(
223:                 ValidationIssue(
224:                     code="group_account_name_mismatch",
225:                     severity=Severity.WARNING,
226:                     message=(
227:                         f"{entity} local account {record.local_code} "
228:                         f"({record.local_name!r}) maps to group account "
229:                         f"{record.group_code}"
230:                         f"{f' ({mapped.account_name!r})' if mapped else ''}, but "
231:                         f"the group chart has the same name at "
232:                         f"{same_name}"
233:                     ),
234:                     entity=entity,
235:                     source_file=record.source_file,
236:                     source_row=record.source_row,
237:                     account_code=record.local_code,
238:                     details={
239:                         "local_name": record.local_name,
240:                         "group_code": record.group_code,
241:                         "name_matched_group_accounts": same_name,
242:                     },
243:                 )
244:             )
245: 
246:     # -- applying ----------------------------------------------------------
247: 
248:     def map_trial_balance(self, tb: TrialBalance) -> MappedTrialBalance:
249:         """Resolve every row of ``tb`` to a group account.
250: 
251:         US uses the identity mapping (local code == group code). UK/IN use
252:         their explicit mapping file. Rows whose local account has no mapping
253:         are still returned (never dropped) with ``mapped=False`` and an
254:         ``unmapped_account`` issue.
255:         """
256:         entity = tb.entity.strip().upper()
257: 
258:         if entity in _MAPPED_ENTITIES:
259:             entries, mapping_source_file = self.load_mapping(entity)
260:             lookup: dict[str, str] = {}
261:             # Only unambiguous records build the lookup; conflicting local
262:             # codes are left unresolved (reported, not guessed).
263:             by_local: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
264:             for entry in entries:
265:                 if entry.local_code and entry.group_code:
266:                     by_local[entry.local_code].add(entry.group_code)
267:             for local_code, group_codes in by_local.items():
268:                 if len(group_codes) == 1:
269:                     lookup[local_code] = next(iter(group_codes))
270: 
271:             issues = self.validate_mapping(entity, entries)
272:         else:
273:             # Identity mapping (US): the local code is already a group code.
274:             lookup = {}
275:             mapping_source_file = None
276:             issues = []
277: 
278:         rows: list[MappedRow] = []
279:         for row in tb.rows:
280:             group_code = self._resolve(entity, row.local_account_code, lookup)
281:             mapped = group_code is not None and group_code in self.group_coa
282:             group_account = self.group_coa.get(group_code) if group_code else None
283: 
284:             if entity not in _MAPPED_ENTITIES and group_code is not None and not mapped:
285:                 issues.append(
286:                     ValidationIssue(
287:                         code="missing_group_account",
288:                         severity=Severity.ERROR,
289:                         message=(
290:                             f"{entity} account {row.local_account_code} is not "
291:                             f"in the group chart of accounts"
292:                         ),
293:                         entity=entity,
294:                         source_file=row.source_file,
295:                         source_row=row.source_row,
296:                         account_code=row.local_account_code,
297:                         details={"group_code": group_code},
298:                     )
299:                 )
300:             if entity in _MAPPED_ENTITIES and group_code is None:
301:                 issues.append(
302:                     ValidationIssue(
303:                         code="unmapped_account",
304:                         severity=Severity.WARNING,
305:                         message=(
306:                             f"{entity} local account {row.local_account_code} "
307:                             f"({row.account_name!r}) has no mapping to a group "
308:                             f"account"
309:                         ),
310:                         entity=entity,
311:                         source_file=row.source_file,
312:                         source_row=row.source_row,
313:                         account_code=row.local_account_code,
314:                     )
315:                 )
316: 
317:             rows.append(
318:                 MappedRow(
319:                     entity=entity,
320:                     source_file=row.source_file,
321:                     source_row=row.source_row,
322:                     local_account_code=row.local_account_code,
323:                     group_account_code=group_code if mapped else None,
324:                     group_account_name=group_account.account_name if group_account else None,
325:                     currency=row.currency,
326:                     debit=row.debit,
327:                     credit=row.credit,
328:                     cost_centre=row.cost_centre,
329:                     mapped=mapped,
330:                     raw=row.raw,
331:                 )
332:             )
333: 
334:         return MappedTrialBalance(
335:             entity=entity,
336:             functional_currency=tb.functional_currency,
337:             source_file=tb.source_file,
338:             mapping_source_file=mapping_source_file,
339:             rows=rows,
340:             issues=issues,
341:         )
342: 
343:     @staticmethod
344:     def _resolve(
345:         entity: str, local_code: str, lookup: dict[str, str]
346:     ) -> str | None:
347:         if entity in _MAPPED_ENTITIES:
348:             return lookup.get(local_code)
349:         # US: identity, but only if the code is a real group account.
350:         return local_code or None

147:         """A serialisable view for ``SkillResult.data`` / traces.

149:         Decimal totals are stringified (full precision preserved), and

153:         return {

190: 
191: def build_stage_ledger(
192:     *,
193:     ingestion: bool,
194:     validation: bool,
195:     mapping: bool,
196: ) -> list[StageOutcome]:
197:     """Compose the stage ledger from what actually executed.
198: 
199:     Any stage not marked implemented in :data:`STAGE_ORDER` is reported
200:     ``BLOCKED`` (missing dependency) rather than silently skipped, so the
201:     caller can always see the unimplemented remainder explicitly.
202:     """
203:     executed = {
204:         "trial_balance_ingestion": ingestion,
205:         "trial_balance_validation": validation,
206:         "account_mapping": mapping,
207:     }
208:     ledger: list[StageOutcome] = []
209:     for stage, implemented, required in STAGE_ORDER:
210:         if not implemented:
211:             ledger.append(
212:                 StageOutcome(
213:                     stage=stage,
214:                     status=StageStatus.BLOCKED,
215:                     detail="service not implemented in consolidation-skill v1",
216:                     required_for_complete=required,
217:                 )
218:             )
219:         elif executed.get(stage):
220:             ledger.append(
221:                 StageOutcome(
222:                     stage=stage,
223:                     status=StageStatus.COMPLETED,
224:                     detail="executed",
225:                     required_for_complete=required,
226:                 )
227:             )
228:         else:
229:             ledger.append(
230:                 StageOutcome(
231:                     stage=stage,
232:                     status=StageStatus.FAILED,
233:                     detail="stage did not complete",
234:                     required_for_complete=required,
235:                 )
236:             )
237:     return ledger

=== group_policies.md ===
# Northwind Group - accounting policies for consolidation (FY2024)

1. **Presentation currency.** The group presents its consolidated statements in GBP.
2. **Translation of entity statements into GBP.**
   - Assets and liabilities: closing rate at 31 December 2024.
   - Income and expenses: average rate for the period in which they are included in the group.
     For the US, the FY2024 average. For India, the H2 (1 July to 31 December 2024) average.
   - Equity: historical rates. Opening group equity is given in `prior_year_group.csv`.
   - Exchange differences on translation go to the translation reserve (account 3300).
   - Where a GBP rate is not given directly, use the product of the two given rates of the same type
     (for example, GBP/INR closing = GBP/USD closing x USD/INR closing).
3. **Foreign currency items inside an entity's own books.** Monetary items in a currency other than the
   entity's functional currency are retranslated at the closing rate. Differences go to profit or loss
   (group account 7300).
4. **Business combinations.** Non-controlling interest is measured at its proportionate share of net assets.
   Goodwill is held in the subsidiary's functional currency and retranslated at the closing rate.
5. **Intercompany.** Intercompany balances, income and expenses are eliminated in full. Items in transit
   at the year end are recorded by the receiving entity at the closing rate. Any remaining exchange
   difference on eliminating intercompany income and expense goes to group account 7300.
6. **Journals.** Manual journals are posted only if they are valid for FY2024. Invalid journals are not posted.
7. **Rounding.** Translate at full precision and round each reported figure to 2 decimal places.

1: """FX rate infrastructure (Stage 1).
2: 
3: Loads the recorded rates from ``fx_rates.csv`` (via the existing
4: :class:`SourceDataService`) and resolves a conversion between two currencies
5: for a given policy rate type.
6: 
7: Resolution order, all using **the same rate type** as requested:
8: 
9: 1. **Direct** — a recorded ``(base -> quote)`` rate for that type.
10: 2. **Inverse** — a recorded ``(quote -> base)`` rate of that type, used as
11:    ``1 / rate``. Justified because the source ``convention`` column states
12:    the rate as "X per 1 base", so the reciprocal is the exact same-type
13:    inverse quote (confirmed by policy review).
14: 3. **Cross** — no direct or inverse pair, but a single intermediate currency
15:    connects them: ``rate(base -> quote) = rate(base -> via) * rate(via -> quote)``
16:    where each leg is itself resolved direct-or-inverse. This implements the
17:    policy rule "use the product of the two given rates of the same type
18:    (for example, GBP/INR closing = GBP/USD closing x USD/INR closing)".
19: 
20: A **missing** rate is a typed :class:`MissingFXRateError` — never a number.
21: A recorded **zero** rate is a valid Decimal zero, distinguishable from
22: missing; inverting a zero rate is impossible and raises
23: :class:`MissingFXRateError` (no fabricated rate).
24: 
25: No rate is ever invented: every returned Decimal is derived only from values
26: present in the source file.
27: """
28: 
29: from __future__ import annotations
30: 
31: from dataclasses import dataclass
32: from decimal import Decimal
33: 
34: from app.accounting.errors import AmbiguousFXRateError, MissingFXRateError
35: from app.accounting.models import FXRate, FXRateType
36: from app.services.source_data import SourceDataService
37: 
38: _ONE = Decimal("1")
39: 
40: 
41: def _load_rate(value: str) -> Decimal:
42:     return Decimal(value.strip())
43: 
44: 
45: @dataclass(frozen=True)
46: class ResolvedRate:
47:     """A resolved conversion plus how it was obtained (for the audit trail)."""
48: 
49:     base_currency: str
50:     quote_currency: str
51:     rate_type: FXRateType
52:     rate: Decimal
53:     method: str  # "direct" | "inverse" | "cross"
54:     legs: tuple[FXRate, ...] = ()
55:     via: str | None = None
56: 
57: 
58: class FXService:
59:     """Resolve currency conversions from the recorded FX rate table."""
60: 
61:     def __init__(self, service: SourceDataService | None = None) -> None:
62:         self.service = service if service is not None else SourceDataService()
63:         self._rates: list[FXRate] | None = None
64: 
65:     # -- loading -----------------------------------------------------------
66: 
67:     @property
68:     def rates(self) -> list[FXRate]:
69:         """Every recorded rate, parsed once and cached."""
70:         if self._rates is None:
71:             rows = self.service.get_fx_rates()
72:             self._rates = [
73:                 FXRate(
74:                     base_currency=r["base_currency"].strip().upper(),
75:                     quote_currency=r["quote_currency"].strip().upper(),
76:                     rate_type=FXRateType(r["rate_type"].strip().lower()),
77:                     rate=_load_rate(r["rate"]),
78:                     as_of=r.get("as_of", "").strip(),
79:                     convention=r.get("convention", "").strip(),
80:                     source_row=index + 1,
81:                 )
82:                 for index, r in enumerate(rows)
83:             ]
84:         return self._rates
85: 
86:     def currencies(self) -> list[str]:
87:         """Distinct currencies appearing as either base or quote."""
88:         seen: set[str] = set()
89:         for rate in self.rates:
90:             seen.add(rate.base_currency)
91:             seen.add(rate.quote_currency)
92:         return sorted(seen)
93: 
94:     # -- lookup helpers ----------------------------------------------------
95: 
96:     def _find(self, base: str, quote: str, rate_type: FXRateType) -> list[FXRate]:
97:         """All recorded rates for an exact ordered pair and type."""
98:         return [
99:             r
100:             for r in self.rates
101:             if r.base_currency == base
102:             and r.quote_currency == quote
103:             and r.rate_type == rate_type
104:         ]
105: 
106:     def _single(self, base: str, quote: str, rate_type: FXRateType) -> FXRate | None:
107:         matches = self._find(base, quote, rate_type)
108:         if len(matches) > 1:
109:             raise AmbiguousFXRateError(
110:                 f"multiple {rate_type.value} rates recorded for {base}/{quote}",
111:                 details={
112:                     "base_currency": base,
113:                     "quote_currency": quote,
114:                     "rate_type": rate_type.value,
115:                     "source_rows": [m.source_row for m in matches],
116:                 },
117:             )
118:         return matches[0] if matches else None
119: 
120:     # -- resolution --------------------------------------------------------
121: 
122:     def resolve(
123:         self,
124:         base_currency: str,
125:         quote_currency: str,
126:         rate_type: FXRateType | str,
127:     ) -> ResolvedRate:
128:         """Resolve ``base_currency -> quote_currency`` for ``rate_type``.
129: 
130:         Raises:
131:             MissingFXRateError: no direct, inverse or cross rate exists, or an
132:                 inverse/cross leg would require dividing by a zero rate.
133:             AmbiguousFXRateError: the source records two distinct rates for
134:                 the same ordered pair and type.
135:         """
136:         base = base_currency.strip().upper()
137:         quote = quote_currency.strip().upper()
138:         rtype = FXRateType(rate_type.value if isinstance(rate_type, FXRateType) else str(rate_type).lower())
139: 
140:         if base == quote:
141:             return ResolvedRate(
142:                 base_currency=base,
143:                 quote_currency=quote,
144:                 rate_type=rtype,
145:                 rate=_ONE,
146:                 method="identity",
147:             )
148: 
149:         # 1. Direct.
150:         direct = self._single(base, quote, rtype)
151:         if direct is not None:
152:             return ResolvedRate(
153:                 base_currency=base,
154:                 quote_currency=quote,
155:                 rate_type=rtype,
156:                 rate=direct.rate,
157:                 method="direct",
158:                 legs=(direct,),
159:             )
160: 
161:         # 2. Inverse (1 / reverse rate).
162:         inverse = self._single(quote, base, rtype)
163:         if inverse is not None:
164:             if inverse.rate == 0:
165:                 raise MissingFXRateError(
166:                     f"cannot invert a zero {rtype.value} rate for {quote}/{base}",
167:                     details={
168:                         "base_currency": base,
169:                         "quote_currency": quote,
170:                         "rate_type": rtype.value,
171:                         "reason": "zero_rate_inverse",
172:                         "source_row": inverse.source_row,
173:                     },
174:                 )
175:             return ResolvedRate(
176:                 base_currency=base,
177:                 quote_currency=quote,
178:                 rate_type=rtype,
179:                 rate=_ONE / inverse.rate,
180:                 method="inverse",
181:                 legs=(inverse,),
182:             )
183: 
184:         # 3. Cross-rate via a shared intermediate currency.
185:         for via in self._cross_candidates(base, quote):
186:             first = self._try_convert(base, via, rtype)
187:             second = self._try_convert(via, quote, rtype)
188:             if first is not None and second is not None:
189:                 return ResolvedRate(
190:                     base_currency=base,
191:                     quote_currency=quote,
192:                     rate_type=rtype,
193:                     rate=first.rate * second.rate,
194:                     method="cross",
195:                     legs=first.legs + second.legs,
196:                     via=via,
197:                 )
198: 
199:         raise MissingFXRateError(
200:             f"no {rtype.value} rate to convert {base} to {quote}",
201:             details={
202:                 "base_currency": base,
203:                 "quote_currency": quote,
204:                 "rate_type": rtype.value,
205:                 "recorded_pairs": sorted(
206:                     f"{r.base_currency}/{r.quote_currency}" for r in self.rates
207:                 ),
208:             },
209:         )
210: 
211:     def _cross_candidates(self, base: str, quote: str) -> list[str]:
212:         """Currencies that appear on both ends of either requested currency."""
213:         connected: set[str] = set()
214:         for rate in self.rates:
215:             for currency in (rate.base_currency, rate.quote_currency):
216:                 if currency not in (base, quote):
217:                     connected.add(currency)
218:         return sorted(connected)
219: 
220:     def _try_convert(
221:         self, base: str, quote: str, rate_type: FXRateType
222:     ) -> ResolvedRate | None:
223:         """Direct-or-inverse resolution for one leg; ``None`` when absent."""
224:         if base == quote:
225:             return ResolvedRate(base, quote, rate_type, _ONE, "identity")
226:         direct = self._single(base, quote, rate_type)
227:         if direct is not None:
228:             return ResolvedRate(base, quote, rate_type, direct.rate, "direct", (direct,))
229:         inverse = self._single(quote, base, rate_type)
230:         if inverse is not None and inverse.rate != 0:
231:             return ResolvedRate(
232:                 base, quote, rate_type, _ONE / inverse.rate, "inverse", (inverse,)
233:             )
234:         return None
235: 
236:     # -- convenience -------------------------------------------------------
237: 
238:     def convert(
239:         self,
240:         amount: Decimal,
241:         base_currency: str,
242:         quote_currency: str,
243:         rate_type: FXRateType | str,
244:     ) -> Decimal:
245:         """Convert ``amount`` at the resolved rate, at full precision.
246: 
247:         No rounding is applied here — the policy rounds only reported figures
248:         (``models.round_reported``).
249:         """
250:         resolved = self.resolve(base_currency, quote_currency, rate_type)
251:         return amount * resolved.rate
```

145: 
146:     A typed failure (invalid period, skill error, ...) is preserved in the

161:     stored = store.save(record)

172:     if result.status.value == "failed":

174:     return response

- **Registry**: `build_default_registry()` registers only `ConsolidationSkill`; mode-gated; `select_by_intent`.
- **MCP**: server exposes 11 read-only tools; `ToolGateway.bind()` enforces budget → policy (`permitted_tools`) → read-only → dispatch, and records every call + trace event. This is the **only** path to source data.
- **Accounting services**: `TrialBalanceIngestor`, `TrialBalanceValidator`, `AccountMapper` (detects the UK 2310 name-mismatch), `FXService` (Decimal, direct/inverse/cross). Raw `get_intercompany` reader exists; **no reconciliation service**.

- **API/UI**: consolidation endpoints + dashboard; runtime injectable per-run via `runner_factory`.

LLM is used only for copilot intent. No structured-output LLM workflows, no LLM trace events, no AI plan/investigation/matching.

{
  "content": "\"\"\"Typed AI reasoning models: plans, proposals and investigations.\n\nThese are the structured outputs the LLM produces and Python validates. Every\nmodel is designed so that **no field can carry an authoritative financial\nfigure the LLM invented**:\n\n* a *proposal* references source rows and offers a candidate decision with a\n  confidence score and explicit ``needs_human_review`` flag — it is never the\n  posting itself;\n* an *extracted fact* always carries its source file/section and a value that\n  Python must cross-check against the source;\n* an *investigation* explains and recommends, but cites the deterministic\n  issue it is reasoning about and never overrides it.\n\nNothing here computes. The deterministic services remain the only source of\naccounting numbers.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\n\nclass Confidence(str, Enum):\n    \"\"\"A coarse, model-reported confidence band (never a financial value).\"\"\"\n\n    LOW = \"low\"\n    MEDIUM = \"medium\"\n    HIGH = \"high\"\n\n\nclass EvidenceRef(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"A pointer back to the exact source record a claim rests on.\"\"\"\n\n    model_config = {\"frozen\": True}\n\n    source_file: str | None = None\n    source_row: int | None = None\n    section: str | None = None\n    account_code: str | None = None\n    note: str = \"\"\n\n\nclass ExtractedFact(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"One accounting fact the LLM extracted from a source document.\n\n    ``value`` is a *reference* the deterministic layer must verify against the\n    source — the LLM never supplies an authoritative figure. ``needs_review``\n    defaults to True so nothing extracted is trusted without confirmation.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    model_config = {\"frozen\": True}\n\n    fact: str\n    value: str | None = None\n    interpretation: str = \"\"\n    evidence: EvidenceRef = Field(default_factory=EvidenceRef)\n    confidence: Confidence = Confidence.LOW\n    needs_review: bool = True\n\n\nclass PlanStep(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"One step of an AI-proposed execution plan.\"\"\"\n\n    model_config = {\"frozen\": True}\n\n    stage: str\n    rationale: str = \"\"\n    # Whether Python can execute this stage automatically today, or whether it\n    # requires human approval / is blocked (mirrors the stage ledger).\n    executable: bool = False\n    requires_approval: bool = False\n\n\nclass ExecutionPlan(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"The structured plan the LLM produces for a consolidation request.\n\n    The plan names period, entities and presentation currency, lists the\n    accounting stages, and separates auto-executable stages from those needing\n    approval. It is advisory: the deterministic skill still decides what it\n    can actually run.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    model_config = {\"frozen\": True}\n\n    period: str | None = None\n    entities: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    presentation_currency: str | None = None\n    workflow: str = \"group_consolidation\"\n    summary: str = \"\"\n    steps: list[PlanStep] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    required_documents: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    approval_stages: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    confidence: Confidence = Confidence.MEDIUM\n    source: str = \"llm\"\n\n\nclass MappingProposal(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"An AI-assisted account-mapping recommendation (never auto-applied).\n\n    Carries the recommended group account, the reasoning, the evidence (the\n    real mapping row and COA entries it compared) and a confidence band. The\n    deterministic mapper only adopts an approved proposal; an unapproved or\n    low-confidence proposal is surfaced for human review.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    model_config = {\"frozen\": True}\n\n    entity: str\n    local_code: str\n    local_name: str | None = None\n    current_group_code: str | None = None\n    proposed_group_code: str | None = None\n    proposed_group_name: str | None = None\n    confidence: Confidence = Confidence.LOW\n    reasoning: str = \"\"\n    evidence: list[EvidenceRef] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    needs_human_review: bool = True\n    # Filled in by the deterministic layer: whether the proposal passed its\n    # own checks (real COA account, name consistency, no material override).\n    verified: bool = False\n    verification_notes: str = \"\"\n\n\nclass AnomalyFinding(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"One possible explanation for a validation anomaly (advisory only).\"\"\"\n\n    model_config = {\"frozen\": True}\n\n    issue_code: str\n    entity: str | None = None\n    account_code: str | None = None\n    hypothesis: str = \"\"\n    recommended_investigation: str = \"\"\n    confidence: Confidence = Confidence.LOW\n    evidence: list[EvidenceRef] = Field(default_factory=list)\n\n\nclass AnomalyInvestigation(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"The LLM's advisory investigation of deterministic validation issues.\"\"\"\n\n    model_config = {\"frozen\": True}\n\n    summary: str = \"\"\n    findings: list[AnomalyFinding] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    note: str = \"Advisory only: deterministic validation results are preserved.\"\n\n\nclass MatchProposal(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"The LLM's proposed intercompany match (never accepted on confidence alone).\n\n    References two source rows by their 1-based row numbers in\n    ``intercompany.csv`` and offers a confidence band and reasoning. Python\n    independently verifies the proposal before it is treated as a match.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    model_config = {\"frozen\": True}\n\n    left_row: int = Field(ge=1)\n    right_row: int = Field(ge=1)\n    match_type: str = \"reciprocal\"\n    confidence: Confidence = Confidence.LOW\n    reasoning: str = \"\"\n    proposed_difference_reason: str = \"\"\n\n    @property\n    def pair(self) -> tuple[int, int]:\n        return (min(self.left_row, self.right_row), max(self.left_row, self.right_row))\n\n\nclass IntercompanyMatchingOutput(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"The LLM's full response for an intercompany candidate-matching call.\"\"\"\n\n    model_config = {\"frozen\": True}\n\n    proposals: list[MatchProposal] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    unmatched_notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    summary: str = \"\"\n\n\nclass AIStageReport(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"The recorded outcome of one AI-assisted stage.\n\n    ``status`` makes the AI availability explicit (``completed`` when it ran,\n    ``not_configured`` when no key is present, ``failed`` when the LLM output\n    could not be used). This is what the frontend renders as the AI stripe.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    model_config = {\"frozen\": True}\n\n    stage: str\n    status: str  # completed | not_configured | failed | skipped\n    detail: str = \"\"\n    call_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)\n",

--- A. execution planning --------------------------------------------------\n\n\nasync def plan_execution(\n    reasoner: LLMReasoner | None,\n    *,\n    request: dict[str, Any],\n    entities: list[dict[str, Any]],\n    skills: list[dict[str, Any]],\n) -> tuple[ExecutionPlan | None, AIStageReport]:\n    \"\"\"Produce a structured execution plan (LLM) or report ``not_configured``.\"\"\"\n    if reasoner is None:\n        return None, _not_configured(\n            \"ai_execution_plan\", \"no LLM configured; deterministic plan used\"\n        )\n\n    user = PLAN_USER.format(\n        request=json.dumps(request, indent=2),\n        entities=json.dumps(\n            [\n                {\n                    \"entity_id\": e.get(\"entity_id\"),\n                    \"functional_currency\": e.get(\"functional_currency\"),\n                }\n                for e in entities\n            ],\n            indent=2,\n        ),\n        skills=json.dumps(\n            [{\"name\": s.get(\"name\"), \"description\": s.get(\"description\")} for s in skills],\n            indent=2,\n        ),\n    )\n    try:\n        plan = await reasoner.reason(\n            template_id=PLAN_TEMPLATE_ID,\n            system_prompt=PLAN_SYSTEM,\n            user_prompt=user,\n            schema=ExecutionPlan,\n        )\n    except LedgerFlowError as exc:\n        return None, _failed(\n            \"ai_execution_plan\",\n            f\"{exc.code}: {exc.message}\",\n            [r.to_payload() for r in reasoner.records],\n        )\n\n    # Cross-check the plan's executable flags in Python: the model cannot\n    # declare a stage runnable that has no deterministic service.\n    checked_steps = [\n        step.model_copy(\n            update={\"executable\": step.stage in _EXECUTABLE_STAGES}\n        )\n        for step in plan.steps\n    ]\n    plan = plan.model_copy(update={\"steps\": checked_steps})\n    return plan, AIStageReport(\n        stage=\"ai_execution_plan\",\n        status=\"completed\",\n        detail=f\"planned {len(plan.steps)} stage(s)\",\n        call_records=[r.to_payload() for r in reasoner.records],\n    )\n\n\n# --- B. account-mapping anomaly investigation -------------------------------\n\n\nasync def propose_account_mapping(\n    reasoner: LLMReasoner | None,\n    *,\n    entity: str,\n    local_code: str,\n    local_name: str | None,\n    current_group_code: str | None,\n    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]],\n    policy_excerpt: str,\n) -> tuple[MappingProposal | None, AIStageReport]:\n    \"\"\"Ask the LLM to investigate one mapping and propose a candidate.\n\n    The proposal is verified in Python before it is reported: the proposed\n    group code must exist in the group chart, and the current mapping is never\n    changed — only recommended.\n    \"\"\"\n    stage = f\"ai_account_mapping.{entity}.{local_code}\"\n    if reasoner is None:\n        return None, _not_configured(\n            stage, \"no LLM configured; deterministic mapping retained\"\n        )\n\n    record = {\n        \"entity\": entity,\n        \"local_code\": local_code,\n        \"local_name\": local_name,\n        \"current_group_code\": current_group_code,\n    }\n    user = MAPPING_USER.format(\n        record=json.dumps(record, indent=2),\n        candidates=json.dumps(candidates, indent=2),\n        policy=policy_excerpt,\n    )\n    try:\n        proposal = await reasoner.reason(\n            template_id=MAPPING_TEMPLATE_ID,\n            system_prompt=MAPPING_SYSTEM,\n            user_prompt=user,\n            schema=MappingProposal,\n        )\n    except LedgerFlowError as exc:\n        return None, _failed(\n            stage,\n            f\"{exc.code}: {exc.message}\",\n            [r.to_payload() for r in reasoner.records],\n        )\n\n    # Deterministic verification: a proposal naming a group code that does not\n    # exist in the chart is rejected and marked unverified.\n    known_codes = {str(c.get(\"account_code\")) for c in candidates}\n    notes: list[str] = []\n    verified = True\n    if proposal.proposed_group_code is not None:\n        if proposal.proposed_group_code not in known_codes:\n            verified = False\n            notes.append(\n                f\"proposed group code {proposal.proposed_group_code!r} is not in \"\n                f\"the supplied group chart candidates\"\n            )\n    else:\n        notes.append(\"no change proposed\")\n    if proposal.proposed_group_code == current_group_code:\n        notes.append(\"proposal matches the current mapping\")\n\n    proposal = proposal.model_copy(\n        update={\"verified\": verified, \"verification_notes\": \"; \".join(notes)}\n    )\n    return proposal, AIStageReport(\n        stage=stage,\n        status=\"completed\",\n        detail=(\n            f\"proposed {proposal.proposed_group_code or 'no change'} \"\n            f\"(confidence={proposal.confidence.value}, verified={verified})\"\n        ),\n        call_records=[r.to_payload() for r in reasoner.records],\n    )\n\n\n# --- C. validation anomaly investigation ------------------------------------\n\n\nasync def investigate_anomalies(\n    reasoner: LLMReasoner | None,\n    *,\n    issues: list[dict[str, Any]],\n    policy_excerpt: str,\n) -> tuple[AnomalyInvestigation | None, AIStageReport]:\n    \"\"\"Ask the LLM to explain deterministic validation issues (advisory only).\"\"\"\n    if reasoner is None:\n        return None, _not_configured(\n            \"ai_anomaly_investigation\", \"no LLM configured; issues left as reported\"\n        )\n    if not issues:\n        return None, AIStageReport(\n            stage=\"ai_anomaly_investigation\",\n            status=\"skipped\",\n            detail=\"no validation issues to investigate\",\n        )\n\n    user = ANOMALY_USER.format(\n        issues=json.dumps(issues, indent=2), policy=policy_excerpt\n    )\n    try:\n        investigation = await reasoner.reason(\n            template_id=ANOMALY_TEMPLATE_ID,\n            system_prompt=ANOMALY_SYSTEM,\n            user_prompt=user,\n            schema=AnomalyInvestigation,\n        )\n    except LedgerFlowError as exc:\n        return None, _failed(\n            \"ai_anomaly_investigation\",\n            f\"{exc.code}: {exc.message}\",\n            [r.to_payload() for r in reasoner.records],\n        )\n    return investigation, AIStageReport(\n        stage=\"ai_anomaly_investigation\",\n        status=\"completed\",\n        detail=f\"investigated {len(investigation.findings)} finding(s)\",\n        call_records=[r.to_payload() for r in reasoner.records],\n    )\n\n\n# --- D. intercompany candidate matching -------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _row_brief(record: IntercompanyRecord) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"row {record.source_row}: {record.reporting_entity} -> \"\n        f\"{record.counterparty} | ref={record.doc_ref} | date={record.doc_date} | \"\n        f\"{record.doc_currency} {record.doc_amount} | booked {record.booked_currency} \"\n        f\"{record.booked_amount} | {record.description}\"\n    )\n\n\ndef verify_matches(\n    reconciler: IntercompanyReconciler,\n    proposals: list[dict[str, Any]],\n    records: list[IntercompanyRecord],\n) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n    \"\"\"Deterministically verify LLM-proposed matches; never trust confidence.\n\n    Returns one dict per proposal with the verdict (accepted, match type,\n    residual, reason). A proposal citing a non-existent row is rejected.\n    \"\"\"\n    results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    for proposal in proposals:\n        left = proposal.get(\"left_row\")\n        right = proposal.get(\"right_row\")\n        if not isinstance(left, int) or not isinstance(right, int):\n            results.append(\n                {\n                    \"left_row\": left,\n                    \"right_row\": right,\n                    \"accepted\": False,\n                    \"match_type\": \"invalid_proposal\",\n                    \"residual\": None,\n                    \"reason\": \"proposal did not reference two row numbers\",\n                    \"confidence\": proposal.get(\"confidence\"),\n                }\n            )\n            continue\n        try:\n            verdict: MatchVerdict = reconciler.verify_pair(left, right, records)\n        except LedgerFlowError as exc:\n            results.append(\n                {\n                    \"left_row\": left,\n                    \"right_row\": right,\n                    \"accepted\": False,\n                    \"match_type\": \"invalid_proposal\",\n                    \"residual\": None,\n                    \"reason\": f\"{exc.code}: {exc.message}\",\n                    \"confidence\": proposal.get(\"confidence\"),\n                }\n            )\n            continue\n        results.append(\n            {\n                \"left_row\": verdict.left_row,\n                \"right_row\": verdict.right_row,\n                \"accepted\": verdict.accepted,\n                \"match_type\": verdict.match_type.value,\n                \"residual\": str(verdict.residual)\n                if verdict.residual is not None\n                else None,\n                \"reporting_currency\": verdict.reporting_currency,\n                \"reason\": verdict.reason,\n                \"confidence\": proposal.get(\"confidence\"),\n                \"reasoning\": proposal.get(\"reasoning\", \"\"),\n            }\n        )\n    return results\n\n\nasync def match_intercompany(\n    reasoner: LLMReasoner | None,\n    reconciler: IntercompanyReconciler,\n    records: list[IntercompanyRecord],\n) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, AIStageReport]:\n    \"\"\"Propose intercompany matches (LLM) and verify them (Python).\"\"\"\n    if reasoner is None:\n        return None, _not_configured(\n            \"ai_intercompany_matching\", \"no LLM configured; no proposals generated\"\n        )\n    if not records:\n        return None, AIStageReport(\n            stage=\"ai_intercompany_matching\",\n            status=\"skipped\",\n            detail=\"no intercompany rows to match\",\n        )\n\n    rows_text = \"\\n\".join(_row_brief(r) for r in records)\n    user = INTERCOMPANY_USER.format(\n        rows=rows_text, reporting_currency=reconciler.reporting_currency\n    )\n    try:\n        output = await reasoner.reason(\n            template_id=INTERCOMPANY_TEMPLATE_ID,\n            system_prompt=INTERCOMPANY_SYSTEM,\n            user_prompt=user,\n            schema=IntercompanyMatchingOutput,\n        )\n    except LedgerFlowError as exc:\n        return None, _failed(\n            \"ai_intercompany_matching\",\n            f\"{exc.code}: {exc.message}\",\n            [r.to_payload() for r in reasoner.records],\n        )\n\n    verified = verify_matches(\n        reconciler,\n        [p.model_dump() for p in output.proposals],\n        records,\n    )\n    payload = {\n        \"summary\": output.summary,\n        \"unmatched_notes\": list(output.unmatched_notes),\n        \"proposals\": verified,\n        \"accepted_count\": sum(1 for v in verified if v[\"accepted\"]),\n        \"proposed_count\": len(verified),\n    }\n    return payload, AIStageReport(\n        stage=\"ai_intercompany_matching\",\n        status=\"completed\",\n        detail=(\n            f\"{payload['accepted_count']}/{payload['proposed_count']} proposal(s) \"\n            f\"verified as reconciling\"\n        ),\n        call_records=[r.to_payload() for r in reasoner.records],\n    )\n",

309: export function ConsolidationDashboard() {
310:   const [run, setRun] = useState<ConsolidationRun | null>(null);
311:   const [trace, setTrace] = useState<ConsolidationTrace | null>(null);
312:   const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
313:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
314: 
315:   const loadTrace = useCallback(async (runId: string) => {
316:     try {
317:       setTrace(await getConsolidationTrace(runId));
318:     } catch {
319:       setTrace(null);
320:     }
321:   }, []);
322: 
323:   const runConsolidation = useCallback(async () => {
324:     setRunning(true);
325:     setError(null);
326:     setTrace(null);
327:     try {
328:       const started = await startConsolidationRun();
329:       setRun(started);
330:       await loadTrace(started.run_id);
331:       // Reflect the run id in the URL so a refresh reloads the same run.
332:       const url = new URL(window.location.href);
333:       url.searchParams.set("run", started.run_id);
334:       window.history.replaceState(null, "", url.toString());
335:     } catch (err) {
336:       if (err instanceof ConsolidationApiError) {
337:         setError(err.message);
338:         if (err.body) {
339:           setRun(err.body);
340:           await loadTrace(err.body.run_id);
341:         }
342:       } else {
343:         setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Consolidation failed");
344:       }
345:     } finally {
346:       setRunning(false);
347:     }
348:   }, [loadTrace]);
349: 
350:   // Refresh path: if the URL carries a run id, load the persisted run.
351:   useEffect(() => {
352:     const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
353:     const runId = params.get("run");
354:     if (!runId) return;
355:     let cancelled = false;
356:     (async () => {
357:       try {
358:         const loaded = await getConsolidationRun(runId);
359:         if (cancelled) return;
360:         setRun(loaded);
361:         await loadTrace(runId);
362:       } catch {
363:         if (!cancelled) setError(`Run ${runId} could not be loaded`);
364:       }
365:     })();
366:     return () => {
367:       cancelled = true;
368:     };
369:   }, [loadTrace]);
370: 
371:   const readiness = run?.readiness ?? null;
372:   const entityOrder = ["US", "UK", "IN"];
373:   const entityKeys = readiness
374:     ? [
375:         ...entityOrder.filter((k) => k in readiness.entities_detail),
376:         ...Object.keys(readiness.entities_detail).filter(
377:           (k) => !entityOrder.includes(k),
378:         ),
379:       ]
380:     : [];
381: 
382:   return (
383:     <div className="space-y-6">
384:       {/* A. Header */}
385:       <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
386:         <div className="flex items-start gap-3.5">
387:           <span className="mt-0.5 flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[#0a1428] text-blue-400 ring-1 ring-slate-900/10">
388:             <BarChart3 className="size-5" aria-hidden />
389:           </span>
390:           <div>
391:             <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
392:               <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
393:                 Group Consolidation
394:               </h1>
395:               {run ? <RunStatusBadge status={run.status} /> : null}
396:             </div>
397:             <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
398:               Reporting period{" "}
399:               <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">
400:                 {readiness ? `FY${readiness.period}` : "FY2024"}
401:               </span>{" "}
402:               · Presentation currency{" "}
403:               <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">
404:                 {readiness?.functional_currency ?? "GBP"}
405:               </span>
406:             </p>
407:           </div>
408:         </div>
409:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
410:           <Button
411:             onClick={runConsolidation}
412:             disabled={running}
413:             aria-busy={running}
414:           >
415:             {running ? (
416:               <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden />
417:             ) : (
418:               <PlayCircle className="size-4" aria-hidden />
419:             )}
420:             {running ? "Running consolidation…" : "Run Consolidation"}
421:           </Button>
422:         </div>
423:       </div>
424: 
425:       {error ? (
426:         <div
427:           role="alert"
428:           className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-rose-700"
429:         >
430:           <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
431:           <span>{error}</span>
432:         </div>
433:       ) : null}
434: 
435:       {run ? (
436:         <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
437:           <span>
438:             Run ID <code className="font-mono text-slate-700">{run.run_id}</code>
439:           </span>
440:           <span>
441:             Trace{" "}
442:             <code className="font-mono text-slate-700">{run.trace_id}</code>
443:           </span>
444:           <span>
445:             Started{" "}
446:             {run.created_at
447:               ? new Date(run.created_at).toLocaleString("en-GB")
448:               : "—"}
449:           </span>
450:         </div>
451:       ) : null}
452: 
453:       {/* B. Entity overview */}
454:       <Card>
455:         <CardHeader>
456:           <CardTitle>Entities</CardTitle>
457:           <CardDescription>
458:             Group entities with their functional currency and actual
459:             validation / mapping status from the backend run.
460:           </CardDescription>
461:         </CardHeader>
462:         <CardContent>
463:           {readiness && entityKeys.length > 0 ? (
464:             <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
465:               {entityKeys.map((key) => (
466:                 <EntityCard
467:                   key={key}
468:                   entity={readiness.entities_detail[key]}
469:                 />
470:               ))}
471:             </div>
472:           ) : (
473:             <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
474:               Run a consolidation to load entity statuses.
475:             </p>
476:           )}
477:         </CardContent>
478:       </Card>
479: 
480:       {/* C + D. Execution status and stage results */}
481:       <Card>
482:         <CardHeader>
483:           <CardTitle>Consolidation stages</CardTitle>
484:           <CardDescription>
485:             Each stage reflects what the backend actually executed. Blocked
486:             stages require accounting services that are not yet implemented.
487:           </CardDescription>
488:         </CardHeader>
489:         <CardContent>
490:           {running ? (
491:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-6 text-sm text-slate-500">
492:               <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden />
493:               Executing the shared agent…
494:             </div>
495:           ) : readiness ? (
496:             <>
497:               <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
498:                 {readiness.stages.map((stage) => (
499:                   <StageRow key={stage.stage} stage={stage} />
500:                 ))}
501:               </div>
502:               {!readiness.complete ? (
503:                 <p className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
504:                   Consolidation is not complete: {readiness.blocked_stages.length}{" "}
505:                   required stage
506:                   {readiness.blocked_stages.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} remain
507:                   blocked and {readiness.pending_stages.length} pending.
508:                 </p>
509:               ) : null}
510:             </>
511:           ) : (
512:             <p className="py-2 text-sm text-slate-500">
513:               No run yet. Use{" "}
514:               <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">
515:                 Run Consolidation
516:               </span>{" "}
517:               to execute the FY2024 group consolidation.
518:             </p>
519:           )}
520:         </CardContent>
521:       </Card>
522: 
523:       <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
524:         {/* E. Issues */}
525:         <Card>
526:           <CardHeader>
527:             <CardTitle>Issues</CardTitle>
528:             <CardDescription>
529:               Accounting inconsistencies flagged by deterministic checks.
530:             </CardDescription>
531:           </CardHeader>
532:           <CardContent>
533:             {run && run.issues.length > 0 ? (
534:               <div>
535:                 {run.issues.map((issue, index) => (
536:                   <IssueRow key={`${issue.code}-${index}`} issue={issue} />
537:                 ))}
538:               </div>
539:             ) : run ? (
540:               <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">No issues reported.</p>
541:             ) : (
542:               <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">No run yet.</p>
543:             )}
544:           </CardContent>
545:         </Card>
546: 
547:         {/* F. Agent activity */}
548:         <Card>
549:           <CardHeader>
550:             <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
551:               <Bot className="size-4 text-slate-400" aria-hidden />
552:               Agent activity
553:             </CardTitle>
554:             <CardDescription>
555:               MCP tool calls recorded during the run, with status and duration.
556:             </CardDescription>
557:           </CardHeader>
558:           <CardContent>
559:             {run && run.tool_calls.length > 0 ? (
560:               <div>
561:                 {run.tool_calls.map((call, index) => (
562:                   <ToolCallRow key={`${call.name}-${index}`} call={call} />
563:                 ))}
564:               </div>
565:             ) : run ? (
566:               <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">No tool calls recorded.</p>
567:             ) : (
568:               <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">No run yet.</p>
569:             )}
570:           </CardContent>
571:         </Card>
572:       </div>
573: 
574:       {/* Trace events */}
575:       {trace && trace.events.length > 0 ? (
576:         <Card>
577:           <CardHeader>
578:             <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
579:               <RefreshCw className="size-4 text-slate-400" aria-hidden />
580:               Execution trace
581:             </CardTitle>
582:             <CardDescription>
583:               Persisted trace events for this run ({trace.trace_id}).
584:             </CardDescription>
585:           </CardHeader>
586:           <CardContent>
587:             <ol className="space-y-1.5">
588:               {trace.events.map((event) => (
589:                 <li
590:                   key={event.seq}
591:                   className="flex items-start gap-3 text-xs text-slate-600"
592:                 >
593:                   <span className="w-6 shrink-0 text-right font-mono text-slate-400">
594:                     {event.seq}
595:                   </span>
596:                   <span className="mt-1 size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-slate-300" />
597:                   <span className="font-mono text-slate-700">
598:                     {event.event}
599:                   </span>
600:                 </li>
601:               ))}
602:             </ol>
603:           </CardContent>
604:         </Card>
605:       ) : null}
606:     </div>
607:   );
608: }
